category: Showcase Verification & Arrow Shape Removal Fixes
scope: Verify showcase/table_advanced.js script and fix arrow shape removal (rightArrow preset / cxnSp connector / table cell arrow shapes) on slides 8 and 9

tasks.title: Comprehensive Audit and Execution Verification of showcase/table_advanced.js
tasks.description: Perform an end-to-end code audit of showcase/table_advanced.js. Verify method call indexing, argument alignments, sequential slide flow, and slide context targeting (specifically slides 8 and 9). Ensure that executing 'node showcase/table_advanced.js' runs cleanly with zero runtime exceptions, creates valid OpenXML output, and opens in Microsoft PowerPoint with zero repair warnings.

tasks.title: Fix Arrow Shape Detection and Cascading Removal in Table Operations
tasks.description: Resolve Bug #2 on slides 8 and 9 where added arrows fail to be removed during table/row/column removal or cell cleaning. Root causes: (1) Arrow shapes use preset 'rightArrow' (or aliases 'arrow', 'right-arrow', 'leftArrow', 'upArrow', 'downArrow') or connector elements (<p:cxnSp>), which get skipped by shape selector queries looking only for standard rects/circles or strict <p:sp> nodes; (2) In CellShapeManager and TableManager boundary-based deletion routines, coordinate calculations for non-rectangular or directional shapes (rotations, arrow head extents, or flipped geometries) fail strict bounding box containment. Fix: ensure shape filtering targets both <p:sp> and <p:cxnSp>, normalizes arrow preset names, and checks arrow bounding coordinates accurately against table, row, column, and cell boundary boxes.

tasks.title: Ensure removeShape and Slide Cleanup Support Arrow and Connector Nodes
tasks.description: Verify slide-level shape removal (removeShape, clearShapes) on slides 8 and 9. Ensure that if the arrow was added as a standalone shape (via addShape) or connector (via addShape with type 'arrow'/'rightArrow'), removeShape matches the shape by either ID (<p:cNvPr id="...">) or name (<p:cNvPr name="...">) across both <p:sp> and <p:cxnSp> elements, and cleanly disbands references in <p:spTree>.

tasks.title: Automated Tests for Arrow Shape Removal and Coordinate Life Cycles
tasks.description: Write automated integration tests in tests/integration/tableArrowShapeRemoval.test.js replicating slides 8 and 9: (1) add arrow shapes to table cells (inside, outside, and shape-only); (2) remove rows and columns containing arrows and assert arrows are purged from <p:spTree>; (3) remove table with arrows and assert zero orphaned arrow nodes remain; (4) test standalone arrow removal via removeShape. Verify with 'npm test' and inspect generated PPTX files in PowerPoint.
